They are GREEN on SCRIP today: this plan removes C from the path, it changes no answer, so a witness guards the answer and the step's own probe reads the C that must be gone.

# probe tokens: gone=TEXT@PATH (TEXT no longer occurs under SCRIP/PATH) | runs=NAME (scrip --run -d262144k -s16384k of harness/fixtures/prolog_boxes/NAME.pl prints NAME.ref) | count=NAME (the user instructions of NAME, less its baseline, recorded in the row's LEDGER before and after: a record, never a gate).
